program.name: Floor Week 35
program.subject: Balanced week
program.blurb: A balanced week with no gear in thirty-five minutes: bodyweight strength, bouts or a Tabata, then yoga or core.
program.about: A balanced week on the floor. One day runs a bodyweight circuit, a few shadowboxing bouts and a yoga flow; the other pairs bodyweight supersets with a Tabata and a core circuit. No equipment and about half an hour. Level II adds reps and Level III brings harder moves.
program.split: Bodyweight circuit, bouts & yoga / bodyweight supersets, Tabata & core, 35 minutes
